catnap.definition:
n sleeping for a short period of time (usually not in bed)
v take a siesta
catnap.translation:
n. 瞌睡, 假寐
vi. 打瞌睡, 假寐

catnaper.translation:
n. [美国英语]瞌睡, 打盹(=catsleep)
vi. 打瞌睡

catnapped.translation: v. 打瞌睡, 假寐( catnap的过去式和过去分词 )

catnapping.translation: v. 打瞌睡, 假寐( catnap的现在分词 )

catnaps.definition:
n sleeping for a short period of time (usually not in bed)
v take a siesta
catnaps.translation: n. 小睡, 小憩( catnap的名词复数 )

catnip.definition: n hairy aromatic perennial herb having whorls of small white purple-spotted flowers in a terminal spike; used in the past as a domestic remedy; strongly attractive to cats
catnip.translation:
n. 假荆芥, 樟脑草
[医] 樟脑草(潞州荆芥)
